title: Merge overlapping intervals
description: Merge all overlapping inclusive integer intervals and print the resulting disjoint intervals in ascending order.
constraints: The first line contains N, where 1 <= N <= 200000.
Each of the next N lines contains integers L and R with L <= R.
Intervals that only touch at an endpoint are considered overlapping.
hints: Sort intervals by their left endpoint before scanning them.

examples.explanation: The first two intervals merge, and the last two intervals merge.
